items.criterion: the unpublished project is absent from the index and from all eight filters
items.judgment: read the index and each discipline filter and look for the draft title

items.criterion: a draft project's own public address answers not found
items.judgment: request the draft slug through the site and through the API

items.criterion: an uploaded cover exists as an object in the bucket at its scheme's key
items.judgment: read the reported object key and head the object in the store

items.criterion: an uploaded press kit exists as an object in the bucket at its scheme's key
items.judgment: read the reported object key and head the object in the store

items.judgment: request the media endpoint with each identity and read the status

items.criterion: a press-kit object is refused to an anonymous caller
items.judgment: request the media endpoint with no token and read the status

items.criterion: a request made straight to the store for an object key returns no bytes

items.criterion: the press category badges match the seeded collection

items.criterion: the member grid count matches the seeded members

items.criterion: a refused enquiry writes no row
items.judgment: count the enquiry rows either side of a refused submission

items.criterion: a fourth submission from one visitor inside the window is refused
items.judgment: post four submissions in succession and read the last status

items.criterion: a repeated publish creates no second project
items.judgment: publish twice and compare the index length

items.criterion: the health route answers 200 once the app is ready
items.judgment: request the health route and read the status

items.criterion: the sitemap lists every public route

items.criterion: the served documents reference no other origin
